name: National Consumer Helpline (Department of Consumer Affairs)
what_for: Register a consumer grievance against any company; the helpline also forwards it to the company.

source.quote: Register your consumer grievance through the NCH Web Portal, Mobile App, UMANG, WhatsApp or Call Centre.

steps.text: Register once on the portal (or call the helpline): sign up with your details and verify through your email.

source.quote: A one time registration is required for lodging a Grievance.

steps.text: Log in and fill in the grievance details, attaching documents if you have them.

source.quote: Using this user id and password, enter into the portal and fill in require details of Grievance attaching necessary documents (if available).

steps.text: You get a unique docket number. Write it down and add it to your case.

source.quote: Any grievance received either through online registration or call center is entered in the portal and a unique docket number is generated and given.

steps.text: Track it any time under 'Track your Grievance'.

source.quote: The status of the Grievance can be tracked from the portal under the link "Track your Grievance" without logging into the portal.

steps.text: The portal says it can take up to 30 days to reach a conclusion.

source.quote: It may take up to a maximum of 30 days to arrive at a logical conclusion.

steps.text: If you are not satisfied, the next step is a Consumer Commission.

source.quote: In case, the consumer is not satisfied, he/she can approach the appropriate Consumer Commission.

attach.text: Documents are optional on the portal, attach what you have.

source.quote: attaching necessary documents (if available)
